note: XXVII cue 97 wide: Ian's Midjourney Q4 bridge take (22 Nov 2:53 a.m.): 'a good spot but the smoke is too much, edit it down'.

beats.text: Make the column of white smoke above the standing woman much smaller and fainter: only a thin, delicate wisp rising a short way above her head, about a quarter of its present height and width, translucent against the sunset, fading out well below the top of the castle ruin. Paint the sunset sky back where the rest of the smoke was. Change nothing else: keep the bridge, the kneeling figures, the chest, the castle, the cliffs, the light and every colour exactly as they are.
